scope: Public main revisions pinned once for the whole refresh, and the deployed GitHub Pages responses, except CultureMech, whose figure is read from its committed README on main because no page it reliably serves states the count; the vocabulary census, subsets and card stats were regenerated at the same pins.

notes.AntibioticMech: 2,939 data/antibiotics records at the pin (2,669 ontology-grounded, 270 minted; 80 REVIEWED, 30 PROPOSED, 2,829 SEEDED), equal to the stat tile. The 95 commits since the previous audit add no records and change no record's curation status. In the records they adopt CRyPTIC Mycobacterium tuberculosis complex activity observations into 26 existing records (56 now carry an activity spectrum, up from 38) and add BioSample accessions to 431 existing activity observations; the rest add 33 record-review reports, attribution updates and tooling, mostly for sources still under evaluation (Stanford HIVDB, NCBI Pathogen Detection AST).
notes.CellStructureMech: 672 data/structures records at the pin, equal to the stat tile (13 categories, 605 GO-grounded, 197 membrane organelles). All 672 are PROPOSED, so none is reviewed. The 130 records added since the previous audit are all GO-grounded and fall mostly under Other (108 to 190) and Ribonucleoprotein (35 to 79).
notes.CommunityMech: The landing tile counts 455 kb/communities records, equal to the pin. data/isolates adds four more, so the census and mech_stats.json count 459. The landing's '16 categories' tile is hard-coded upstream in src/communitymech/templates/landing.html; the schema enum, the records and the browser facet all have 15. The PaCMAP map covers 322 communities and the graph layout 292, against 455 in the browser. No GitHub release has been published.
notes.CultureMech: The committed README's corpus snapshot states 15,878 normalized and 6,288 merged records, equal to data/normalized_yaml and data/merge_yaml/merged at the pin; no page CultureMech reliably serves states the canonical count. The app/ landing tile still reads 10,657, a legacy figure that matches no data layer. The pages/ media index, app/data.js and the dashboard are deployed only by CultureMech's generate-pages workflow, last run on 2026-09-22; branch-based Pages builds since 2026-09-25 replaced that deployment, so all three returned 404 on 2026-09-28 (#175). The three commits since the previous pin track YAML review reports, removing them from .gitignore, and add review-skill text; no record, README or schema changed.
notes.HabitatMech: 3,206 data/habitats records at the pin (686 REVIEWED, 2,520 SEEDED; 2,151 ontology-grounded; 176 attested by two or more sources), equal to the stat tiles. The 173 commits since the previous audit add 171 record-review reports, an iModulonDB cross-check section in two review skills and a .gitignore rule; no record changed.
notes.MediaIngredientMech: The landing tiles (2,953 ingredients, 2,611 mapped, 88% coverage) are computed from data/ingredients.json, whose records also hold 261 UNMAPPED, 80 REJECTED and 1 AMBIGUOUS; every count equals the data/ingredients records at the pin. browser.html reads the file's metadata block instead, which counts files per directory (2,680 under mapped/, 273 under unmapped/). The six commits since the previous audit edited 20 mapped records (#754) and changed no status count.
notes.NaturalProductMech: The landing prose states 3,115 natural product structures, equal to data/natural_products at the pin; all are SEEDED. The 96 commits since the previous audit add no records: a re-seed set biosynthesis_origin on every record and computed taxon-group facets from producers (3,076 records) and occurrences (2,342), and curation added biosynthetic pathways (68 records, from 1) and causal graphs (108, from 27).
notes.ProteinTraitsMech: 429,293 records and 34 source labels, computed at runtime from data/facets.json and equal to data/traits at the pin (39,591 REVIEWED, each with causal graphs; 388,593 SEEDED; 1,109 PROPOSED). The 34 are the browser's facet labels: its fallback label "manual" groups 102,089 records from GO, Complex Portal, OrthoDB, IEDB and four smaller sources. The 28 commits since the previous audit add UniProt-grounded canonical examples to 9,801 more records (142,247 now carry them) and change no record count, axis, category or status. The static HTML still carries a legacy fallback of 408,978 / 29.
notes.TaxonMech: 625,960 data/taxa records at the pin, equal to the stat tile and including 14 retained DEPRECATED records; none is REVIEWED. The two commits since the previous audit (972fbd7) touch only the review-yaml skills and .gitignore; records, pages and the README are unchanged.
notes.TraitMech: 834 data/traits records at the pin (427 REVIEWED, 319 PROPOSED, 50 DEPRECATED, 38 SEEDED; 590 with causal graphs), equal to the landing page at the pin, which showed 10 categories and 57.2% embedded (477 of 834). The 71 records added since the previous audit are all PROPOSED GENOMICS traits with TraitMech-minted identifiers, mostly anti-phage defense systems; none has a kg-microbe embedding.
